law_name: Ordinance No. 03-05 of 19 July 2003 on Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (collective, pseudonymous, anonymous, posthumous and audiovisual works: 50 years from end of year of first publication)
fair_use_exceptions: Statutory exceptions (quotation, private copying with levy)
enforcement_body: Office National des Droits d'Auteur et Droits Voisins (ONDA)
